result.edit: The failure shows the output was 0 when expected to be 1 at cycle 2 in mode 0 (even period). The current code uses div_o>>1 for the odd period threshold, but the specification requires floor(div_o/4)+1. Changing to div_o>>2 matches the specification by using a right shift of 2 bits (equivalent to division by 4) instead of 1. This ensures the output goes high when clk_cnt is less than or equal to the correct threshold during odd periods.
